name: Give_2
short_caption: The robot extends both hands slightly forward with open palms turned upward in a small giving gesture.
movement_description: Starting from a neutral posture, the robot gently lifts both arms forward from the elbows while turning its palms to face upward. It holds this open, inviting hand posture briefly with a subtle forward lean of the upper body. Finally, the arms are smoothly lowered back down to the sides, returning the robot to its initial neutral rest pose.
safety_notes: The arms extend slightly forward, requiring a clear space of about 30 cm directly in front of the robot.
